i2c_note: SLB9673 is a fixed-function I2C TPM (Trusted Platform Module), not an MCU alt-fn mux. SDA/SCL are single-purpose silicon pins -- no possible_roles menu, function_class=fixed applies to them specifically. Per the interim protocol-pins-only standard (adopted after INA219's STOP #2 -- see kb/vendor/ti/INA219AIDCNR.json provenance.a0_a1_decision), TEST#, RST#, I2C_PIRQ#, VDD, GND, GPIO_00/01/02, and the NC/NCI pads are deliberately NOT KB'd here. On jetson-agx-thor-baseboard (U14), none of these land on the I2C_SYS bus: RST#(17) ties to a transistor gate net (Net-(Q1-D)), TEST#(20) straps high to +3V3, I2C_PIRQ#(18) has its own dedicated net (/Peripherals/TPM_IRQ or /TPM_IRQ depending on hierarchical sheet), GPIO_00/01/02 are unconnected, VDD/GND/EP tie to +3V3/GND -- so this landing carries no STOP-2-shape strap-on-bus churn risk. U14's SDA/SCL wiring on the real board is already correct (no swap). This is the fifth and capstone landing of the initial non-MCU KB batch: with SLB9673 landed, every currently-KB-able resident of the jetson I2C_SYS bus (INA219 x5, AT24CS01, PCAL6408A, SLB9673) is now covered -- the bus's residual Step-7 UNRESOLVABLE churn (a connector and a test point, neither a real IC, both permanently un-KB-able) is a stable, fully-accounted-for floor, not an open gap.
